segments.text:
V. 15.
Go ye into all the world, and preach the goſpel to every creature Our LORD ſpeaks without any Limitation or Reſtriction. If therefore every Creature in every Age hath not heard it, either thoſe who ſhould have preached, or thoſe who ſhould have heard it, or both, made void the council of GOD herein.
